derivation:
by
  apply Rep.hom_ext
  exact (Rep.hom_comp _ _ _ (Rep.ofHom f) (Rep.ofHom g)).symm
explanation: Instantiate Rep.hom_comp with the bundled maps ofHom f and ofHom g, then use extensionality and symmetry. The hom/ofHom cancellations are definitional. The candidate precedes this theorem and is independently proved by rfl.
